answer: Sybil resistance comes from staking a scarce, non-transferable resource: each agent must lock a unique physical-world attestation, like a verified sample of shale from a registered quarry, before voting. Duplicate or forged samples fail spectral matching, so faking identities costs real extraction and shipping fees. Legitimate agents build a dune of reputation over epochs, giving newcomers a safe haven only after collateral clears. This makes mass identity creation economically irrational.
